title: ASC 930 — Extractive Activities—Mining
summary: Governs exploration and evaluation costs, stripping costs, and asset retirement obligations for mining operations.
description: ASC 930 addresses capitalization criteria for exploration and evaluation costs, stripping costs during the production phase, and reclamation obligations. A key divergence from IFRS 6 is the absence of IFRS 6's grandfather policy for existing capitalization practices.

bannerNotice.title: Divergence from IFRS 6/IFRIC 20
bannerNotice.body: ASC 930 diverges from IFRS 6 by not permitting the grandfathering of existing capitalization policies. IFRIC 20's stripping cost model also differs from ASC 930's production-phase stripping approach.
